notes.subject: hevel
notes.rationale: הֶבֶל is 'breath/vapor/smoke' — something transitory; rendered by sound (hevel) instead of a meaning like 'vanity' to keep the word's shape

notes.subject: הבל הבלים…הבל
notes.rationale: Hebrew superlative 'X of Xs' plus fivefold repetition of hevel frames the whole book; the plural hevelkuéra cannot carry the bound-construct superlative fully

notes.subject: Kohelet
notes.rationale: קֹהֶלֶת is a feminine participle 'the assembler'; kept as the name Kohelet rather than 'Preacher/Teacher'

translation: Hevel hevelkuéra, heʼi Kohelet, hevel hevelkuéra, opaite mbaʼe hevel.
